title: Why We're Sleepy After Eating Sugar?

cards.prompt: Order what happens in the body after eating sugar, leading to a crash.
items: Sugar is absorbed for energy and blood sugar drops
cards.answer: Spike, insulin release, absorption and drop, then fatigue.

cards.prompt: Which organ releases insulin after you eat sugar?
The tired feeling after a sugar spike is called a sugar ____.
Which hormone linked to calmness may add to post-sugar drowsiness?
cards.answer: Serotonin, which regulates mood and relaxation and can cause drowsiness.
The rapid entry of sugar into the bloodstream.

cards.prompt: Explain like I'm 10: what happens to extra glucose your body doesn't need right away?
cards.answer: Your body stores it for later. It moves the extra sugar into muscles, the liver and fat cells.

cards.prompt: Eating lots of sugar can make you fat because extra glucose gets stored in fat cells.
cards.answer: Fact: glucose beyond what's needed for energy is stored, including in fat cells.

cards.prompt: You eat a huge sweet dessert at lunch and feel sluggish at 2pm. Explain what is going on in your body.
cards.answer: Blood sugar spiked, insulin pulled it down, causing an energy swing, and serotonin may add drowsiness. Excess glucose also gets stored away.
